extracted.name: Cinnamon Rolls
extracted.description: This cinnamon roll recipe makes home- style cinnamon rolls from scratch without using yeast in just ten easy steps. Yes, that’s right, no yeast. This means you can make and eat your cinnamon rolls in less than an hour.
ingredient_lines: In order to make the dough, you’ll need;
instruction_lines: Directions; Step 1: In a bowl, mix together flour sugar baking powder and salt.
Step 2: Cut in softened butter/ margarine and mix it using your hands.

Step 3: Add milk as you continue mixing with your hands till you form soft dough. You can take out the dough from the bowl and continue mixing on a lightly floured surface to achieve the desired texture of the dough.
Step 4: Roll out the dough on a lightly floured surface into a rectangle that is about ¼ inch thick.
Step 5: In a small bowl mix the brown/white sugar and cinnamon.
Step 6: Spread the butter on the rolled out dough, followed by the crumbly mixture of cinnamon and sugar.
Step 7: Roll up the rectangle and slightly pinch the edges to seal it, then with a sharp knife slice into 12 rolls. If you want them a little smaller you can make up to 16 rolls.
Step 8: Place your rolls on a non-stick baking tray or grease it with butter/ margarine if it is non- stick then bake for 20-25 minutes at 200 degrees Celsius.
Step 9: For the glaze, combine powdered sugar and milk in a bowl and stir until smooth.
Step 10: Once the rolls are done drizzle the glaze while they are still warm so that the glaze will melt into the cracks making every bite full of deliciousness.
